pages.text: Press $(k:use) on the $(item)wheel$() to take the helm. $(k:left) and $(k:right) turn the wheel smoothly; let go of the keys and it stays where you left it. Press $(k:sneak) to step away.
She turns faster the faster she's going, and barely at all when she's stopped. Watch the bar above your hotbar: it shows the wind, your speed and how well your sail is drawing.
